simOnly: Canvas/browser backend is SIM / NOT FOR FLIGHT
canonicalization: trace args are Q8.8 floor(v*256); non-finite as nan/inf/-inf

review.reason: Re-pin the two built-in PFD drum fixtures after true-airspeed, groundspeed, and barometric-setting labels size to their readout boxes. Both fixtures still verify deterministic rolling-digit replay. No entry is added or removed. Each hand-built scene is unchanged.
review.approvedBy: REN-04 owner; regenerated goldens require human review and are never rewritten by CI.

entries.name: empty-background-canonical
entries.notes: The byte-exact empty Background layer from the scene-layer protocol doc.

entries.name: attitude-every-drawing-opcode
entries.notes: Every non-text drawing opcode in one Attitude layer.

entries.name: multi-layer-pfd
entries.notes: Ascending Attitude, Tapes, Annunciation bands.

entries.name: extreme-attitude
entries.notes: Large roll/translate placing the horizon far off center.

entries.name: frame-edge-overhang
entries.notes: Ink crossing all four design-frame edges is a valid scene, not a fault: the gate accepts it, no raw-argument guard fires, and both backends replay the overhanging coordinates verbatim. The design-frame clip itself is surface-side, outside what the corpus records.

entries.name: extreme-coordinate-in-range
entries.notes: Large but representable device coordinate; both backends draw it (fully clipped).

entries.name: background-imagery
entries.notes: Replaceable Background band with fill and polygon.

entries.name: failure-display
entries.notes: Failure band reversion content; nothing may cover it.

entries.name: unknown-opcode-counted
entries.notes: A well-framed unknown opcode inside a layer is counted, not fatal.

entries.name: text-covered
entries.notes: Digit covered by the controlled pack; both backends render from the atlas.

entries.name: text-centered-multichar
entries.notes: Center-anchored multi-digit run at a readout-like size: both backends place the run from the same nominal advance, so a centered readout value lands identically.

entries.name: text-uncovered
entries.notes: Character absent from the pack: both backends fail the run, neither substitutes a font.

entries.name: pfd-altitude-drum-mid-roll
entries.notes: The built-in PFD at 1010 ft: the altitude readout's digit pair sits mid-scroll between its 00 and 20 faces inside a clipped window, so both backends place the strip's fractional offset from the same bytes.

entries.name: pfd-altitude-drum-negative-cascade
entries.notes: The built-in PFD at -90 ft: a claimed minus ahead of the drum, and the hundreds column rolling in lockstep with the pair's 80-to-00 face. The negative-altitude path replays byte-identically on both backends.

entries.name: paint-non-finite
entries.notes: Gate accepts; the software rasterizer spoils on a non-finite coordinate and the browser interpreter's raw-argument guard throws before Canvas2D sees it.

entries.name: paint-out-of-range
entries.notes: Gate accepts; the software rasterizer spoils on an out-of-range device coordinate and the interpreter's raw-argument guard rejects the same value.

entries.name: paint-too-many-vertices
entries.notes: Gate accepts; both backends enforce the shared per-shape vertex budget — the rasterizer via its fixed buffer, the interpreter via its path guard.

entries.name: paint-non-finite-rotate
entries.notes: A NaN rotation poisons the transform: the rasterizer spoils on the first mapped point, the interpreter's angle guard throws at the rotate itself.

entries.name: paint-out-of-range-translate
entries.notes: An out-of-range translation: the rasterizer rejects in device space, the interpreter rejects the raw argument.

entries.name: paint-non-finite-arc-angle
entries.notes: A non-finite arc start angle: the rasterizer spoils computing the sweep, the interpreter's angle guard throws.

entries.name: paint-out-of-range-stroke-width
entries.notes: A stroke width beyond the coordinate limit: the interpreter rejects the raw argument; the reference outcome pins whatever the rasterizer does with it.

entries.name: bad-version
entries.notes: Unsupported format version: both backends reject at framing.

entries.name: truncated-tail
entries.notes: A valid scene missing its last byte: framing and decode both reject.

entries.name: malformed-line-payload
entries.notes: A LINE opcode with a 4-byte payload where 16 are required: JS framing passes on the declared length, the reference decoder rejects the payload.

entries.name: unknown-layer-id
entries.notes: A begin-layer marker naming an id this revision cannot place: framing passes, decode rejects.

entries.name: truncation-sweep
entries.notes: Framing verdict at every prefix length must match the reference command boundaries.

entries.name: duplicate-layer
entries.notes: Attitude opened twice.

entries.name: out-of-order-layer
entries.notes: Tapes then Attitude descends the z-order.

entries.name: nested-layer
entries.notes: Tapes opened while Attitude is open.

entries.name: end-without-begin
entries.notes: A stray end marker.

entries.name: end-mismatch
entries.notes: Attitude closed by a Tapes end marker.

entries.name: unclosed-layer
entries.notes: The scene ends with Attitude still open.

entries.name: unisolated-state
entries.notes: A command before the isolation save.

entries.name: unbalanced-state
entries.notes: The isolation save is left open at layer end.

entries.name: command-outside-layer
entries.notes: A drawing command before any layer opens.

entries.name: unknown-opcode-outside-layer
entries.notes: An unknown opcode decodes but sits outside any layer.

entries.name: stack-depth-at-limit
entries.notes: Peak graphics-state depth equals the 32 budget.

entries.name: stack-depth-over-limit
entries.notes: One save past the depth budget.

entries.name: layer-commands-at-limit
entries.notes: Layer command count equals the 4096 budget.

entries.name: layer-commands-over-limit
entries.notes: One command past the per-layer budget.

entries.name: scene-bytes-at-limit
entries.notes: Encoded scene equals the 65536-byte budget.

entries.name: scene-bytes-over-limit
entries.notes: One byte past the scene budget.
